# Feature: Dashboard a11y

<!-- auto-generated by /implement on 2026-08-14 — issue #26 -->

## Intent
Core dashboard journeys are keyboard-complete. Automated Axe on those routes reports no critical or serious violations. `prefers-reduced-motion` turns off decorative animation. 200% zoom does not clip primary actions.

## Preconditions
- Setup detect (#22), live run (#23), run detail + timeline (#24, #25)

## Happy Path
- [x] Automated Axe on core routes has no critical/serious violations
- [x] Documented keyboard path: Setup confirm, Run start, Abort, Finding open
- [x] prefers-reduced-motion disables decorative animations
- [x] Touched files: zero type escape hatches

## Edge Cases
- [x] 200% zoom: primary actions remain visible
- [x] Skip link moves focus to main
- [x] Missing run still has an empty state, not a score

## Regression
- [x] Existing fixture e2e still pass
- [x] Token not in localStorage
- [x] Scope: dashboard a11y + axe hook — not Settings integrations

## Assumptions
- Core routes: `/setup/detect`, `/runs/new`, `/runs/:id/live`, `/runs/:id?tab=findings`
- Golden run id `01J9GOLDENV100000000000000`
- UI copy is English
- Axe tags WCAG 2.2 A/AA; only critical/serious fail the gate

## Security Coverage
- F-03: token stays in memory
- B-03: `/healthz` is loopback-only liveness, not a protected resource
- F-01 waived (loopback)
- Out of scope: B-01, B-04, P-04 (no auth redesign, no SQL, no uploads)

## Implementation Notes
- Skip link before nav; `main#main` is the focus target. Sidebar wraps under 768px.
- Global `prefers-reduced-motion` sets animation/transition to none.
- Loopback `GET /healthz` (Host-checked, no token) so Playwright can wait on the e2e API.
- `scripts/e2e-local-api.mjs` binds 8787 with token `e2e-a11y-token` and `runHoldMs` 60s so Abort stays available.
- Axe via `@axe-core/playwright` on detect, new run, live, findings; fail only critical/serious.
- Keyboard path documented in README. Tabs no longer point `aria-controls` at unmounted panels.

## Composition Gate
- Verdict: CLEAR
- HEAD_SHA: WORKTREE
- Event: keyboard/Axe scan of core screens (1 page → N checks; fail-closed on critical/serious).
- N-actors: one dashboard session → N route scans; abort is one POST per run id.
- Invalid: missing run stays empty/error, not a score; `/healthz` is liveness without a token.
- Two consumers: Playwright URL probe vs Bearer-protected `/api/v1/*`.
